GOOD TO KNOW

The SIP edge restarts once during this update, which drops calls in progress. Install at a quiet time.

ElevenLabs agents on calls are built and tested against a stand-in, not yet against a real ElevenLabs account. Before the first real call, see "ElevenLabs phone calls" in the help: the post-call webhook and its secret are set in ElevenLabs, and ElevenLabs' SIP addresses may need allowing under Firewall → Carriers.

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

ElevenLabs agents take phone calls: add an ElevenLabs phone connection under AI → AI providers, choose it under Phone calls on an ElevenLabs agent in AI → AI agents, and publish. The agent gets its own number at ElevenLabs and then appears, with its picture, in call flows and campaigns beside Vapi agents. It can hand the caller back to a person, and its summary, transcript and results come back into the call's history and reports.

The Academy for every role: everyone always sees My courses and their certificates, including people on roles with their own list of screens. Team progress and assignments still need supervisor rights, and settings need administrator rights.

FOR AGENTS

Bookshelf links: books and chapters on the desk have their own addresses, so they open in a new tab and survive a reload, and Back turns back through them. Training shows once, as the first book on the shelf.

FOR PLATFORM OPERATORS

Tenant export and import carry the bookshelf's books with their articles, and a book whose title the target already has is matched to it instead of failing the import; the report says which. A data export also carries people's Academy progress, certificates and assignments, and what they have read; a setup-only export leaves them out."}
